english.title: Harbour an escaped patient from a mental institution
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly

(A)_[harboured **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a patient who was absent without leave]_
(B)_[harboured **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a patient who was at large]_
(C)_[gave assistance to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a patient who was absent without leave]_
(D)_[gave assistance to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a patient who was at large]_

and liable to be retaken under the Mental Health Act 1983, with intent to prevent, hinder or interfere with

(E)_[his being taken into custody]_
(F)_[her being taken into custody]_
(G)_[his return to the hospital where he ought to be]_
(H)_[her return to the hospital where she ought to be]_
(I)_[his return to **(..SPECIFY PLACE..) where he ought to be]_
(J)_[her return to **(..SPECIFY PLACE..) where she ought to be]_
english.legislation: Contraryto section 128(3) and (4) of the Mental Health Act1983.

date and location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 130 of the MentalHealth Act 1983 provides that a local social services authority may instituteproceedings for any offence under this Part of this Act, but without prejudiceto any provision of this Part of this Act requiring the consent of the Directorof Public Prosecutions for the institution of such proceedings.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
